title: Short Squeeze in US Long Bonds Shows ‘Bessent Put’ at Work
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s surprise plan to tamp down US borrowing costs by expanding bond buybacks may have sparked fierce debate about its ultimate effectiveness, but key market metrics and positioning show that it’s having an impact.

title: US-Canada Cosmetic Tariffs Threaten the $10 Beauty Impulse Buy
summary: In between offering advice on how to find the best towels and where to buy affordable versions of high-end garments, Bryce Gruber recently waded into the US-Canada trade war, warning her social-media followers that some of their favorite makeup is about to get more expensive.

title: Congress Will Have to Act to Address $40T US Debt, Says Fmr. Rep. Kevin Brady
summary: Kevin Brady, former Republican Congressman from Texas, said that the US is failing to restrain spending, even as the US brings in record revenues. Brady said that congress will have to act to reduce spending, including looking at programs like Social Security and Medicaid that are moving towards insolvency issues.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Oil Dips on Fresh Iran War Diplomacy, Talks on Hormuz
summary: Oil extended declines as fresh diplomatic efforts helped renew optimism the Iran war would not escalate, while a US plan to ramp up economic pressure on Tehran spared the country’s trading partners from harsher measures for now.

title: Copy Trading Offers Alternative to Traditional Investing
summary: Steven Wang, Founder & CEO of Dub, launched the copy trading platform 3 years ago after dropping out of Harvard to become an entrepreneur. He says the app offers a unique alternative to sports betting, and fresh opportunities for the increasing number of young Americans who say they are now investing their money to grow try and grow their wealth. Wang says Dub is for great traders who "don't need to go the traditional sort of boys club and Wall Street path to really become the next superstar." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Braskem’s $11 Billion Debt Rework Puts Spotlight on Petrobras
summary: Braskem SA’s announcement of an $11 billion debt restructuring staved off an immediate crisis that would have pushed it into bankruptcy protection. But the parties remain far apart on key issues ranging from terms of shareholder support to how existing debt will be reworked.

title: Stocks Rise Before Nvidia as Oil Drop Lifts Bonds: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks rose as a decline in oil prices sent bond yields lower, with traders awaiting Nvidia Corp.’s earnings for clues on whether the outlook for artificial intelligence remains intact.

title: Binance Hires Two Senior Compliance Executives From Crypto.com
summary: Binance Holdings Ltd. has hired two senior compliance executives from Crypto.com as the exchange bolsters ranks in that department after a number of staff departures and ongoing regulatory scrutiny.

title: US Natural Gas Falls as Iran Pressure Plan Pulls Down Energy
summary: US natural gas futures ended lower, but pared back most losses, after earlier being pulled down by crude and European gas futures. Those global energy prices fell on a US plan to increase economic pressure on Iran that seemed less likely to affect physical supply than investors expected.

title: United Airlines CEO on Expansion Plans, Airfares, Demand
summary: United Airlines Chief Executive Officer Scott Kirby discusses the largest international expansion in the company’s history, the strength he sees in both customer demand and the US economy, and plans to offset increased oil prices. The carrier will now fly to 10 more destinations in Europe and Asia. Kirby speaks to Bloomberg's Lisa Abramowicz from United's hub at Newark Liberty International Airport in New Jersey. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Guggenheim Investments Says Affiliates May Buy Its Hard-Hit Loan
summary: Guggenheim Investments, the asset-management arm of Mark Walter’s Guggenheim Partners, is telling lenders that affiliates may look to buy portions of a loan issued by its financing entity after the debt’s value collapsed in recent weeks.

title: New Iran Sanctions Part of 'Piecemeal Strategy,' Says Rep. Gabe Amo
summary: Representative Gabe Amo, a Rhode Island Democrat, called the US threat of sanctions against countries doing business with Iran more of the president's "piecemeal strategy" that's leaving the administration "grasping at straws." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Russia Mulls Extending Diesel-Export Ban Amid Kyiv Attacks
summary: Russia is discussing extending its ban on diesel exports as Ukraine continues to strike the nation’s refineries at a record pace.

title: Aston Martin Set to Drop Out of FTSE 250 as Turnaround Splutters
summary: Luxury carmaker Aston Martin Lagonda Global Holdings Plc is set to leave the FTSE 250, a move that would cement its status as a small-cap stock and highlight its faltering turnaround.

title: Franklin’s Araghi Says Nvidia Holders Want Map, Not Just a Beat

title: Bessent’s Mentor Druckenmiller Calls Bond Buying a Mistake
summary: Stanley Druckenmiller, the billionaire investor who mentored US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent in his early career as a hedge fund trader, suggested his former pupil is making a mistake by wading into the bond market.

title: Wall Street Keeps Minting Box ETFs Despite Treasury Scrutiny
summary: An exchange-traded fund strategy that delivers Treasury bill-like returns with lower taxes is getting a fresh boost as Wall Street firms bet the approach will survive rising scrutiny from the US Treasury.

title: Matt Dalton, Fixed-Income Expert Who Led Belle Haven, Dies at 62
summary: Matt Dalton, a fixed-income portfolio manager who in 2002 founded Belle Haven Investments out of a former broker-dealer firm, has died. He was 62.

title: Software Stocks Get an Earnings Gut Check After Hot Summer Rally
summary: Software investors are betting that the struggling stocks have found their footing again after a strong performance over the past month. Earnings this week can confirm that this latest rally has staying power.
